name: web-cdp-wooden-blocks-photo-with-icon-and-network-cube
title: 'CDP' wooden letter blocks photo with icon blocks and a hand placing a network-cube block
whatItIs: A photo of wooden cube blocks spelling 'CDP' on a light wood table, with two blocks above showing a people-and-chart icon and a monitor-with-chart icon, and a hand placing a third block with a connected-cube network icon into position.
whatItMeans: Tangible and approachable; physical wooden blocks make an abstract software acronym feel graspable and concrete.
techniques: Spell an acronym with physical letter blocks for a tactile concept photo.
Pair each letter with an icon block explaining its meaning.
Show a hand mid-action to suggest the concept is still being assembled.

vocabulary.definition: A staged photo representing an abstract business or tech idea.
A physical cube used to spell out words or acronyms.
